_help.description: Documentation only; never forwarded as model instructions.

functional.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent correctness review. Select for code comprehension, project language, boundary behavior, and regressions.

risk.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent risk review, source checks, and comments. Select for cross-path failure analysis and reliable MCP tool use. Standalone /pr-check uses review.risk.

verifier.description: Exact provider/model ID for source-based verification, counterevidence, duplicate merging, and the final report. Select for evidence judgment, long context, and instruction following, not just summarization.

deep.description: Optional deep profile. Missing or empty roles disable deep mode; it never falls back to review models.

functional.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent correctness review. Select for code comprehension, project language, boundary behavior, and regressions. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

risk.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent risk review, source checks, and comments. Select for cross-path failure analysis and reliable MCP tool use. Standalone /pr-check uses review.risk. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

verifier.description: Exact provider/model ID for source-based verification, counterevidence, duplicate merging, and the final report. Select for evidence judgment, long context, and instruction following, not just summarization. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

azure.description: Obsolete, ignored. Retained only so existing installed profiles can be reused. Configure MCP and permissions in OpenCode.

initial.description: Iteration budget for each of the two normal-mode initial reviewers.

deep.description: Iteration budget for each of the two deep-mode initial reviewers.

enabled.description: Allow the explicit saved-preview publishing stage. MCP permissions remain governed by OpenCode.

maxComments.description: Maximum comments in a saved preview; publication follows prompt instructions.

outputLanguage.description: Shared output language for final report Markdown and Azure comment prose. Use a language tag; intermediate reviews, JSON fields, identifiers, severity labels, and status receipts are unchanged. Restart OpenCode after changes.

structuredOutput.description: Use the OpenCode 1.18.31 StructuredOutput transport for review envelopes. Set false explicitly when complete native submissions are unreliable; JSON text keeps the same evidence validation and rejects duplicate keys or incomplete finish reasons. No automatic transport or model fallback. An authorized output amendment may accept complete JSON text after the pinned missing-native error, with full validation and an explicit notice.

shellToolPermission.description: Private AZPR roles only. Default deny hides the native shell tool. Explicit ask retains its schema for providers that reject requests without it; the runtime still blocks execution before host approval. Other native denials and ordinary agents stay unchanged. No provider detection, automatic fallback or allow mode. Restart OpenCode after changes.

outputRetries.description: Opt in to one shared status/location/merge amendment or complete final content resubmission per stage. Narrow amendments preserve existing fields; final resubmission may replace evidence and decisions only with a matching frozen snapshot and known unchanged current source/target versions. Same stopped verifier context, configured model, one request, no ordinary tools, unchanged deadline, full validation and retained original failures. Status-only initial responses cannot regenerate a review. Provider errors, invalid outer JSON, truncation, unknown/stale versions, cancellation, unconfirmed aborts and comments do not qualify. A scoped amendment may accept complete JSON text after the pinned missing-native error with disclosure. Extra model usage may be billed.

enabled.description: Save private stage inputs, visible answers, errors, and results locally. May contain confidential source or model-echoed secrets. No automatic cleanup.

directory.description: Empty uses XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode/azpr-debug (default ~/.local/state/opencode/azpr-debug). Otherwise an absolute path or path relative to the active OpenCode project directory. No tilde expansion.

runTimeoutSeconds.description: Whole-command time limit including all stages, status amendments and report display. Exceeding it returns TIMED_OUT. The budget does not restart for each stage and is not a spending cap.
